column:reports.generated_at: timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
constraint:reports.reports_values_ck: CHECK (((version >= 1) AND ((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['DRAFT'::character varying, 'PUBLISHED'::character varying, 'SUPERSEDED'::character varying])::text[])) AND ((period_type)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['weekly'::character varying, 'monthly'::character varying, 'half_year'::character varying, 'annual'::character varying, 'custom'::character varying])::text[])) AND (period_from <= period_to) AND (((status)::text = 'DRAFT'::text) = (published_at IS NULL)) AND (((status)::text = 'DRAFT'::text) OR (published_by IS NOT NULL))))
index:reports.reports_office_period_idx: CREATE INDEX reports_office_period_idx ON public.reports USING btree (office_id, period_from DESC)
index:reports.reports_one_draft_uq: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reports_one_draft_uq ON public.reports USING btree (office_id, period_type, period_from, period_to) WHERE ((status)::text = 'DRAFT'::text)
index:reports.reports_one_published_uq: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reports_one_published_uq ON public.reports USING btree (office_id, period_type, period_from, period_to) WHERE ((status)::text = 'PUBLISHED'::text)
index:reports.reports_pkey: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reports_pkey ON public.reports USING btree (report_id)
index:reports.reports_version_uq: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reports_version_uq ON public.reports USING btree (office_id, period_type, period_from, period_to, version)
